thesis.prediction: AAPL should pull back to the level_hvn_2 support near 343.41 within the next 2 sessions, hold it, and rally toward high_20 at 360.83 within 10 sessions after entry.
thesis.reason: In an established uptrend with a bull-high SPY regime, a pullback to the level_hvn_2 volume support, which sits above level_pivot_low_2, offers a defined-risk entry after the extension above sma_200. The target is the high_20 level.
thesis.invalidation_text: A close below level_pivot_low_2 at 338.70 would mean the level_hvn_2 support failed and the pullback is turning into a deeper trend break.

thesis.prediction: HD should pull back to the sma_20 area near 335.71 within the next two sessions, hold it, and rise to the level_hvn_4 resistance at 349.18 within about 10 sessions.
thesis.reason: The uptrend has price above sma_20, sma_50 and sma_200, so a dip into the sma_20/ema_21 cluster is a pullback to support inside a trend. level_hvn_4 at 349.18 is the next volume resistance above, so the target sits there. The stop sits under sma_200 at 332.56, beyond both the sma_20 and ema_21 supports.
thesis.invalidation_text: A close below 332.56 (sma_200) would mean the sma_20/ema_21 support has failed and the pullback has become a trend break, which voids the reason for the long.

thesis.prediction: JPM should hold the congestion_low near 336.67 and bounce toward sma_50 at 340.01 within 3 sessions after entry.

thesis.invalidation_text: A close below 335.11 (level_hvn_1) would mean the range low and volume support failed, so the range-hold reason no longer applies.

thesis.prediction: JPM should pull back to level_hvn_1 at 335.11, hold above it, and rise toward level_pivot_high_1 at 344.40 within about 10 sessions after entry.

thesis.invalidation_text: A close below 333.00 (level_pivot_low_2) would mean support under the high-volume node gave way, so the uptrend pullback reason is broken.

thesis.prediction: A relief bounce in UNH should stall at the broken low_20 near 342.46 and roll over, with price back at the 330.48 close area within about 10 sessions of entry.
thesis.reason: The close of 330.48 is below low_20 (342.455) and below sma_20, sma_50 and sma_200 after a heavy-volume selloff, so the broken support at low_20 should act as resistance on a rebound. Declining quarterly earnings add to the downtrend, but the stop is kept well below hvn_1 (376.09) because a bounce from oversold RSI could run far.
thesis.invalidation_text: A close above 349.00 would mean price has reclaimed the broken low_20 breakdown level, so the resistance-retest reason no longer holds and the selloff is likely being repaired.
